name: Changelog Change Entry
description: One categorized narrative statement describing an intentional release change.

fields.description: Stable deterministic machine ID for this release change.
Exact Registry release version that owns the change.
Human-readable title for the change entry.
Full human-readable description of the change.
Stable machine change type, aligned to the canonical changelog category.
Original human section label where historical notes were migrated.
Concise release-note text retained for backward-compatible projections.
Canonical Registry IDs explicitly affected by the change.
Derived domains of explicitly affected Registry IDs.
Derived Module IDs associated with explicitly affected Registry IDs.
Structured compatibility, migration, action and security impact metadata.
Exact per-change Diff evidence when explicitly linked; null when unavailable.
Migration guide reference when one exists.
Deprecation record reference when one exists.
Repository source/evidence reference supporting this change entry.
Commit or tag reference only when authoritative evidence exists.
Controlled provenance class for the release-note statement.
Additional bounded context that does not override canonical contracts.

relationships.description: Governed by the NEXT F Changelog Standard.
Each change entry carries structured impact/action metadata.

validationRules.description: category and changeType must resolve to registry/changelog/sections.json and agree.
entryId remains stable and unique across the release train.
Every current affectedRegistryId must resolve; historical/removed references require explicit historical evidence.
Unknown breaking, migration or action state is represented as null rather than guessed.
Per-change Diff, migration, deprecation and compatibility assertions require explicit evidence.
Entry text and references must not contain secrets or customer runtime records.
